meta.title: KORD BREACH named-POI map intelligence
meta.objectiveIndexing: Zero-based index into each quest's objectives array in kord_breach_quests.json.
meta.coordinateSpace: Escape from Tarkov world x/z coordinates. Tarkov.dev map-label positions are stored as [x, z] and are copied here without interpolation.
meta.confidencePolicy: Every record is a broad named-POI reference, never an exact KORD objective or interaction coordinate.

source.provenance: Only labels on Tarkov.dev interactive maps were used. The current pvp-season task feed contains no matching KORD BREACH task records or objective zones, so no seasonal zone coordinates were used.

limitations: Named POIs locate a general landmark, not the KORD interaction point within or around that landmark.
Objectives without a defensible matching Tarkov.dev label or official seasonal objective zone are intentionally omitted.
Some objectives have multiple valid areas; a marker is included only for the named area supported by the source label.
